limitations: PARTIAL scope: 9 of 689 raw files are not annotated. Experiment 32D (20160706_ASK_CS_32D1..32D7.raw, searched by MaxQuant) and Experiment 27C (20160706_ASK_CS_27C6.raw, 20160706_ASK_CS_27C7.raw, in the design but not in summary.txt, i.e. not searched) are not among the 113 samples of the paper/Dataset EV2 (no 32D or 27C column; legend defines only A/B/C), so their sample identity is undocumented (rule 7). 27C6/27C7 may be the missing fractions 6-7 of 27aC (5 fractions) or of 27bC, but no source says so. combined_NAT.zip (MaxQuant combined folder) is also not an SDRF data file.

Age is EV1 "Age" listed under "Diagnosis pre-treatment" (age at diagnosis) and is written on the post-treatment (B, C) rows too; surgery was about 4-15 months later (130-455 days; patient 15 has surgery dated before diagnosis), so for some patients the age at surgical sampling may be one year higher. Computing it from EV1 dates of birth was rejected (several DOBs are 1 January placeholders; patient 15 has surgery before diagnosis).
Healthy donors (34C-38C): age, ancestry and donor IDs are not published; individual = "healthy_donor_NN" is my pseudonym from the sample number.

Super-SILAC composition: the paper cites Geiger et al. 2010 for the "breast super-SILAC mix" but does not list its cell lines; SN= names, sex and organism part of the reference are therefore not available.
Miller & Payne score and relapse are custom characteristics columns (no template column fits; NCIT has no per-grade Miller-Payne terms); parse_sdrf may report them as unknown/extension columns.

Ancestry and cell type not stated anywhere -> not available. Tumour size (EV1 coded 1-4 categories) and lymph node status are not written: the template wants number+unit for tumor size and a TNM mapping would be my inference.

Fraction identifiers 6/7 on 14 early-batch samples are MaxQuant design fraction numbers for re-injected pooled SCX fractions (1-3 and 4-5), not distinct SCX fractions; kept as the deposited search defines them.
techsdrf not installed; instruments read from raw-header model strings, HCD from the Andromeda .apar, no per-scan verification of collision energy or scan ranges.
